annotations.title: Voice agent: spoken question in, spoken answer out, with memory

description: One turn of a voice assistant: send the user's voice note (or text), your instructions and the earlier turns; get back what was heard, a short reply, the reply spoken in English or Spanish and the updated history to send next time. Speech up to 2 minutes (MP3/WAV, or 1 MB of other formats); replies up to 600 characters. Use for voice bots in Telegram or WhatsApp, phone menus, kiosks and hands-free helpers. Example: text=What time do you open on Saturday?. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

history.description: Earlier turns as a JSON array of {role, content}, as returned in history by the last call

instructions.description: Who the assistant is and what it knows (up to 2,000 characters)

lang.description: Reply language and voice: en or es (Aura-2 MP3); fr, zh, ja and ko are retired, so a request for them is a 422 (MeloTTS was removed from Workers AI, 20 Nov 2026); default en

text.description: The user's turn as text (or send audio with url or a POSTed file)

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the user's spoken turn (MP3/WAV up to 2 minutes, other formats up to 1 MB); or POST the file; or send text instead

voice.description: Aura-2 voice for an en or es reply (default luna for en, aquila for es)
